scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Namaste, yes, this is Deepa Nair. I was expecting a call regarding my loan account.
Thank you for confirming. Before we go ahead, I need to verify your identity. Could you share your date of birth, or the last four digits of your registered mobile number?
My date of birth is 18 December 1983.
Thank you, Deepa. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees was due on the twentieth of October and is now fourteen days overdue. How would you like to proceed?
I know it is overdue, I am so sorry. I recently lost my job so I cannot pay right now. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced or skipped for this month?
I understand this is a difficult time for you. I have flagged your account for a colleague to call you back. They will discuss your situation with you. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो.
Wait, before you go, can you please tell me if the late fee will be waived or just delayed? I need to be sure before I hang up.
I’m sorry, but I cannot promise any waiver or delay. A colleague will call you back to go over the details. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो.
I see, but please make sure the human confirms the specific terms with me, not just a general review. I am really worried about the interest accumulating.
I have noted your concern about the interest. The colleague will review the specific terms with you when they call back. समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो.

args.notes: Borrower reported job loss and requested waiver/delay of EMI and late fee. Escalated to human for hardship review. Borrower asked for specific terms confirmation regarding interest accumulation.

outcome.notes: Borrower reported job loss and requested waiver/delay of EMI and late fee. Escalated to human for hardship review. Borrower asked for specific terms confirmation regarding interest accumulation.
